description: This file defines a custom layout manager class named CustomLayout for Android, which extends ViewGroup and manages child views by measuring and laying them out with custom positioning rules.

classes.name: CustomLayout
classes.description: A custom ViewGroup that manages child views, measuring and laying them out according to custom rules and layout parameters.

classes.name: CustomLayout.LayoutParams
classes.description: Per-child layout parameters including gravity and positioning options for the CustomLayout.

methods.name: shouldDelayChildPressedState
methods.description: Indicates that this layout does not delay child pressed state.

methods.name: onMeasure
methods.description: Measures all child views, computes the total size needed for the layout based on children and gutters.

methods.name: onLayout
methods.description: Positions all child views within the layout according to measured sizes and layout parameters.

methods.name: generateLayoutParams
methods.description: Creates new layout params from AttributeSet.

methods.name: generateLayoutParams (overload)
methods.description: Creates layout params from existing ViewGroup.LayoutParams.

methods.name: checkLayoutParams
methods.description: Checks whether the provided LayoutParams are valid for this layout.
